اخشوشنوا (form XII)
# اِخْشَوْشَنُوا (iḵšawšanū) /ix.ʃaw.ʃa.nuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِخْشَوْشَنَ (iḵšawšana)
# اِخْشَوْشِنُوا (iḵšawšinū) /ix.ʃaw.ʃi.nuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِخْشَوْشَنَ (iḵšawšana)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
